title: Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box Anime Announced for 2027, Reveals Teaser Visual and Trailer
content: The anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya’s Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box has been officially announced for 2027. A teaser visual, teaser trailer, and the main staff were revealed alongside the announcement.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Nanatsuya: Shinobu no Housekibako' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya 's Nanatsuya: Shinobu no Housekibako ( Nanatsu-ya: Shinobou and Her Jewelry Box ) on Wednesday, revealing the main staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Premieres Next April
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Ichika Isshiki and fame's Berserk of Gluttony ( Bōshoku no Berserk: Ore Dake Level to Iu Gainen wo Toppa Suru ) light novel series announced the opening of the new season's website, and also revealed its teaser visual and April 2027 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Reveals Teaser Visual, April 2027 Release Date
content: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 will officially premiere in April 2027, with a new teaser visual revealed for the announcement. An official website for the second season has also opened. The anime previously confirmed that it would return next year .
author: Anime Corner

title: Aoharu Once More Light Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, More Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the light anime of Toworu Miyata 's Aoharu Once More boys' love manga unveiled a new teaser promotional video for the anime on Wednesday. The teaser announces the anime's main cast, additional staff members, and January 2027 premiere date on TV Tokyo .
author: ANN

title: 3 New Anime to Watch If You Miss 90s Anime
content: 1990s was the greatest decade for the anime industry, as it introduced several iconic films and series that are still loved even now. The animation styles were distinctive, and the music was unforgettable, which made them even more memorable.
author: ComicBook

title: 12 Years Ago, Naruto Reached Its Controversial Ending & It Isn’t As Bad As You Remember
content: The legacy of the Shonen Big Three remains unmatched even though several years have passed since their debut. As the new era of the anime and manga industry began with shorter and seasonal series, fans appreciate the older generation even more with long-running stories and captivating plots.
author: ComicBook

title: Kodansha Launches 1999Tokoyo Building Horror Game on Steam
content: Kodansha Game Lab launched the 1999Tokoyo Building game for PC via Steam on Monday. 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know?
author: ANN

title: Mameshiba Characters Get Oyatsushiba Spinoff Short Net Anime
content: Kim Sukwon's Mameshiba character franchise is inspiring a spinoff short net anime titled Oyatsushiba that will premiere on YouTube on Friday, November 14 at 6:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EST). There are 20 weekly episodes, each about one minute long, in what the staff describes as the "first batch" for Oyatsushiba .
author: ANN
